skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 3 combo strikes for 40% ATK DMG (+3).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks targets in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo strikes for 50% ATK DMG (+3). Also grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks targets in a cross-shaped area with 3 combo strikes for 55% ATK DMG (+3). Also grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 35% of own HP).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After any character's action, increases the ATK of allies in a [Tenacity-type state] (Tenacity/Resilience) by 25%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After any character's action, increases the ATK of allies in a [Tenacity-type state] (Tenacity/Resilience) by 35%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After any character's action, increases the ATK of allies in a [Tenacity-type state] (Tenacity/Resilience) by 40%.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
